analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($884.74) vs SMA5/20/50 ($926.94/$950.55/$978.59): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming entry into a weak phase.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($970.74/$746.62): Below long-term moving averages, suggesting potential trend weakening.
· 52-week position (64.2%) + Current price level remains elevated from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.1→42.0): Entering oversold territory, confirming strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.0717→-1.0717): Remaining in negative territory, confirming continued bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $815.44): Approaching the lower band, opening possibility for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($854.35): Approximately 3.7% below current price, a support zone linked to Pivot S1 ($792.92).
· Swing resistance ($1011.77): Approximately 14.4% above current price, potential for trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Failed Higher Low recovery, now consolidating): Confirming lack of directional bias after failed trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.27x): Increased compared to the last 5-day average, confirming added strength to the downward move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Short-term selling pressure intensifying, consider buying only after RSI exits oversold and MACD shows signs of rebound.
